name: Punctuality
overview: Scripture highlights the importance of diligence and timely action, contrasting the consequences of slothfulness with the value of purposeful effort. Ecclesiastes reminds us that there is a proper season and time for every purpose, underscoring the wisdom of punctuality and order. Proverbs illustrates that those who delay or neglect their responsibilities suffer loss, while the diligent are honored and their work is precious. This teaches believers to honor God by managing their time wisely and faithfully fulfilling their duties.
